def run(_context):
    import json, adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    product = doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType')
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(product)
    
    setups = cam.setups
    setup = setups.itemByName('Setup1')
    print('=== SETUP1 DETAILS ===')
    print(f'Name: {setup.name}')
    
    # Check setup parameters
    params = setup.parameters
    for i in range(params.count):
        p = params.item(i)
        try:
            print(f'  {p.name}: {p.expression}')
        except:
            print(f'  {p.name}: (no expression)')
    
    # Check stock
    print(f'\n=== STOCK ===')
    stock = setup.stock
    print(f'Stock mode: {stock.stockMode}')
    
    # Check WCS - use the setup's model origin
    print(f'\n=== WCS ===')
    wcs = setup.workCoordinateSystem
    origin = wcs.origin
    print(f'WCS origin: ({origin.x}, {origin.y}, {origin.z})')
    xAxis = wcs.xAxis
    yAxis = wcs.yAxis
    zAxis = wcs.zAxis
    print(f'X axis: ({xAxis.x}, {xAxis.y}, {xAxis.z})')
    print(f'Y axis: ({yAxis.x}, {yAxis.y}, {yAxis.z})')
